notes.title: April 5, 2023 Playtest Patch Notes
notes.content:
We updated the Survivor Mercs playtest version with various fixes and improvements:
[list]
[*] Improved the level-up effect to appear more pronounced 
[*] Bosses and Mini-Bosses now have a name and HP bar directly above them and in the HUD
[*] Added fully textured buildings, more obstacles, and improved overall lighting of the game
[*] Added trails for various weapon and powerup projectiles
[*] Knockback effects are now more reliably pushing enemies away
[*] Improved the end-of-run summary window
[*] Adjusted and improved various weapon effects
[*] Improved randomization algorithm to distribute drops more fairly
[*] Added the "heavy-boned" Commander trait
[*] The enemy, "Charger", shows its dash path more clearly
[*] Reduced time to capture the Supply Drops
[*] Increased distance at which objectives are revealed
[*] Fixed the issue where the Commander kept running when an objective is captured
[*] ...and various other bugfixes and smaller visual improvements
[/list]

We're looking forward to hearing your feedback. Please [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2141520/Survivor_Mercs]join our Discord server[/url] to become part of the discussion.

notes.title: Patch Notes for Playtest Version (Mar 15, 2023)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed Mercs getting lost on the map. When getting stuck, they will not teleport closer to you, off-screen, so they can catch up again.
[*] Added individual models for the stronger enemy evolutions of the base enemy types.
[*] Made Charger and Blob enemies easier to distinguish visually.
[*] Fixed random 1.000.000 damage indicators caused by enemies falling through the ground.
[*] The Commander can no longer capture objectives when dead.
[*] Mammoth boss now deals melee damage.
[*] Mammoth boss can no longer be outrunned.
[*] Fixed scale of enemy fragments when getting killed.
[*] Powergloves now affect Silverback, Priest and the One-Man Army aura.
[*] Fixed scrolling with mouse wheel in the Bunker HQ menu.
[*] Fixed Commander's footstep VFX.
[*] improved stability for intro and extro animations, hopefully ending less often in blocked game states.
[*] Fixed potential blocker where game became unresponsive after capturing objectives or getting killed.
[*] Stun VFX should now correctly disappear when affected enemy dies.
[*] Chemtrail's and Scorch's weapon VFX cover less of the enemies, Commander and Mercs.
[*] Elite enemies (mini-bosses) now drop Loot and DNA as intended. (DNA cannot be spent in currently)
[/list]
